subtitles.en: Peggy, tell me about digit five. What is new on this generation of humanoid platform?
subtitles.zh: Peggy，请介绍一下Digit 5。这一代人形平台有什么新进展？

subtitles.en: So digit five is the first humanoid to be able to work in close proximity to other humans.
subtitles.zh: Digit 5是首款能够近距离与人协同工作的人形机器人。

subtitles.en: That means the physical safety barriers that have kept them separated from humans up until now is coming down. And agility has solved for that problem. And it will allow humanoids to come
subtitles.zh: 这意味着此前将机器人与人类隔开的物理安全屏障正在被打破。Agility已经解决了这个问题，这将允许人形机器人

subtitles.en: outside of that work cell and operate throughout a facility. Peggy, how is agility solved for that?
subtitles.zh: 走出工作单元，在整个设施内运行。Peggy，Agility是如何解决这个问题的？

subtitles.en: When I am reporting on and investigating the progress of the field, humanoid robotics, a lot of the work is actually on the software side, right, making sure that there's a grounding
subtitles.zh: 在我报道和调研人形机器人领域进展时，很多工作实际上是在软件层面，确保有扎实的

subtitles.en: in real world physics, so that the humanoid of any type can be in close proximity to its human colleagues or counterparts. Like, where did you focus the work with digit five?
subtitles.zh: 现实物理基础，让人形机器人无论类型都能与人类同事或伙伴近距离共处。那么，你们在Digit 5上的工作重点是什么？

subtitles.en: It actually was a little bit of both. So the hardware itself had to be improved.
subtitles.zh: 实际上两者都有涉及。硬件本身必须改进。

subtitles.en: Digit has 360-degree vision. It needs to be able to see all around so that it can monitor, observe for humans, and when humans become within a certain very or a certain radius,
subtitles.zh: Digit拥有360度视觉。它需要能够环顾四周，以便监测和观察人类，当人类进入一定半径范围内时，

subtitles.en: it will bring itself safely down to the ground until the human passes.
subtitles.zh: 它会安全地降至地面，直到人类通过。

clip_research.source_claim: Digit 5 is the first humanoid able to work in close proximity to humans, removing physical safety barriers, and it has 360-degree vision that makes it sit down when a human enters a certain radius.
clip_research.public_baseline: Agility Robotics officially unveiled Digit 5 on Sept 15, 2026, describing it as its first humanoid engineered for 'cooperatively safe work at scale' without physical safety barriers, with more than $300 million in multi-year orders.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The transcript frames the barrier removal as already solved, while the official announcement notes certain safety features remain in development and do not eliminate all operational risk.

evidence.fact: Digit 5 is the first humanoid to work in close proximity to humans, removing physical safety barriers.

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
